title: input-centric OFTv2 Mirror views
hypothesis: Input-side matrix-free Mirror Givens task codes retain independent-map quality with fewer actual bytes and lower active compute than dense native OFTv2 task transforms.
mirror_coordinate: Eight learned Givens rotations applied to input activation per task
controls: native OFTv2-style dense input-side orthogonal transform per task
shared map plus Mirror Givens input views

storage.authority: actual torch.save inference payload plus canonical JSON metadata

success_gate: Mirror MSE <=1.10x independent, payload <=60% independent, and lower bytes than OFTv2 with MSE <=1.10x OFTv2.
failure_gate: Mirror misses quality/byte gate or OFTv2 matches at equal/lower bytes and runtime.
boundaries: no natural language or capacity claim
